# Cypherox — Full Index

> Cypherox Technologies is an AI-native software and product engineering company (founded 2015) that builds AI agents, generative AI systems, and machine learning products, and takes them from prototype into production. This file is the complete index of every public page on cypherox.com, grouped by area. For a curated, high-signal overview, see https://www.cypherox.com/llms.txt

- Legal name: Cypherox Technologies Pvt. Ltd
- Founder and CEO: Vipinraj Nair (https://www.linkedin.com/in/vipinraj-nair)
- Offices: Rajkot, Gujarat, India; Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India; London, United Kingdom
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/cypherox-technologies
- Contact: https://www.cypherox.com/get-in-touch
- Book a call: https://www.cypherox.com/schedule-a-call
- Last updated: 2026-09-23

## AI agents and generative AI

- [AI Agent Development Services](https://www.cypherox.com/ai-agent-development-services): Custom multi-step AI agents that call tools and integrate with CRMs, ERPs, and internal APIs; strategy, development, behaviour training, integration, and monitoring.
- [Generative AI Development Services](https://www.cypherox.com/generative-ai-development-services): LLM applications, RAG pipelines, fine-tuning, domain-specific models, and generative AI agents, with guardrails and audit trails; cloud, private cloud, or on-premises.
- [AI Development Services](https://www.cypherox.com/ai-development-services): End-to-end AI engineering across agents, generative AI, and machine learning, from discovery through production.
- [AI & ML Development Services](https://www.cypherox.com/artificial-intelligence-and-machine-learning-services): ML engineering from data preparation and training through deployment and monitoring.
- [AI & ML Product Development](https://www.cypherox.com/ai-and-ml-product-development-services): Building complete AI-first software products, not just models.
- [AI Sales Agent for E-Commerce](https://www.cypherox.com/ai-sales-agent-for-ecommerce): AI agents that guide shoppers and support conversion on e-commerce stores.
- [AI Sales Assistant for E-Commerce](https://www.cypherox.com/ai-sales-assistant-for-ecommerce): Conversational AI shopping assistant for discovery and checkout.
- [AI App Development](https://www.cypherox.com/ai-app-development-services): Mobile and web applications with AI built in from the start.
- [AI SaaS Solutions](https://www.cypherox.com/ai-saas-solutions): Engineering for SaaS products that ship AI to their own customers.
- [Chatbot SaaS Solutions](https://www.cypherox.com/chatbot-saas-solutions): Conversational AI products delivered as SaaS.
- [AI Chatbot Mobile Apps](https://www.cypherox.com/ai-chatbot-mobile-app-solutions): Chat-based AI assistants for iOS and Android.
- [Virtual Assistant Services](https://www.cypherox.com/virtual-assistant-services): AI assistants for scheduling, support, and task automation.
- [Virtual Assistant Apps](https://www.cypherox.com/virtual-assistant-app-solutions): Standalone virtual assistant applications.
- [AI Language Translator Apps](https://www.cypherox.com/language-translator-app-solutions): Translation apps built on neural machine translation and speech models.

## Machine learning and data

- [Fraud Detection Solutions](https://www.cypherox.com/fraud-detection-solutions): ML models that flag suspicious transactions and behaviour.

## Case studies (with reported outcomes)

- [AI Healthcare Voicebot for Patient Monitoring](https://www.cypherox.com/our-work/ai-healthcare-voicebot-patient-monitoring): Outbound AI voice agent running scheduled check-in calls, extracting clinical data, scoring risk, and alerting doctors; weekly follow-up coverage rose from ~30% to 100%, saving 200+ staff hours/month.
- [AI Lead Qualification Engine for a B2B SaaS Company](https://www.cypherox.com/our-work/ai-lead-qualification-saas-revenue-growth-case-study): ML lead scoring and routing; lead-to-demo conversion rose from 1.8% to 6.3%, MRR from $28K to $84K, sales cycle from 42 to 27 days.
- [Luxury Furniture E-Commerce Platform](https://www.cypherox.com/our-work/luxury-furniture-ecommerce-platform-case-study): Custom e-commerce platform for a luxury furniture retailer.
- [Custom Email Marketing Platform](https://www.cypherox.com/our-work/custom-email-marketing-platform-case-study): Purpose-built email marketing and campaign platform.
- [Luxury Home SEO Case Study](https://www.cypherox.com/our-work/luxury-home-seo-case-study): Search visibility program for a luxury home brand.
- [Foster Care Website Design](https://www.cypherox.com/our-work/foster-care-web-design-case-study): Website design and build for a foster care organisation.
- [LuxeLife Brand Identity](https://www.cypherox.com/our-work/luxelife-brand-identity-case-study): Brand identity design project.
